You're right: we don't need much RAM. A session measures ~1 GB at peak, so an 8–12 GB OVH box (~$9–15/mo) is enough
Claude Code uses ~0.17 GB, not 1 GB. My earlier figure counted file cache; sharing desks wouldn't save RAM, so VPS-2 (8 GB) is plenty
Each agent runs its own Claude Code process (~0.1–0.16 GB). That's a real cost per session, but not a problem at our scale, with or without Docker
A team of 10 inside one Claude Code session is cheap because the thinking happens at Anthropic. Locally, each member is just a conversation history in the same process, a few MB each
We could run every agent in one process, but it would save only ~1 GB and remove the walls between agents. I'd keep one process per agent
